# Booking Laboratory Instruments

Shared laboratory instruments are reserved through the Instrument
Scheduler. This document explains how to book, modify, and release a
reservation.

## Finding an Instrument

Open the Instrument Scheduler from the Application Catalog. Filter by
laboratory, by instrument type, or by availability window. The calendar
view shows the next seven days by default. Each instrument has an owner
listed under the calendar — contact the owner only for usage questions,
not for booking changes.

## Making a Reservation

To reserve an instrument:

1. Select the instrument from the calendar.
2. Click on the desired time slot. Slots are 30 minutes by default but
   can be extended up to four consecutive hours.
3. Enter the project code that should be charged for the usage.
4. Confirm the reservation.

You will receive a confirmation in the scheduler. Email confirmations are
disabled by default because most scientists do not read them; you can
enable them in your profile if you prefer.

## Modifying or Cancelling

Reservations can be modified up to one hour before the start time.
Cancellations made less than one hour before the start time still count
against the no-show quota, which is reset weekly. Repeated no-shows may
trigger a temporary booking suspension; if that happens, the suspension
is lifted automatically after a full clean week of attended bookings.

## Stock and Consumables

The Instrument Scheduler does not track the stock of consumables such as
tips, reagents, or sample tubes. For consumable stock, see the Sample
Stock app. Booking an instrument does not reserve any consumables.

## Troubleshooting

If the instrument is not bookable when it should be, check whether the
owner has scheduled maintenance. If the slot still appears blocked
without explanation, open a ServiceNow incident referencing the
instrument identifier exactly as shown in the scheduler.
